purpose: Teach: に当たって/満たし/満たさ/遂げ/併せ/略し/測っ/揃える

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約に当たって注意点をまとめろ
lines.en: Compile a summary of key points before we finalize the contract.
lines.style: Brisk, authoritative opening. Sharp consonants. No hesitation. The tone of someone giving instructions they expect will be followed. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社は規格を満たしております
lines.en: Yes. Our products meet all the required specifications.
lines.style: Measured, professional confirmation. Even pace. Slight upward lift on 'specifications' to signal competence. Respectful but steady — not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 品質を満たさない製品は出荷停止しろ
lines.en: Any products that fail to meet quality standards must be held from shipment.
lines.style: Firm statement of policy. Slight pause before 'must' to emphasize the non-negotiable nature. Cool, matter-of-fact delivery. No room for interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社はトップを遂げました
lines.en: Understood. We've already achieved the highest standards in our division.
lines.style: Confident, factual acknowledgment. Steady tempo. Pride in the accomplishment without overstatement. The quiet confidence of someone delivering good news.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各部門併せて報告しろ
lines.en: Report back with consolidated findings from all departments.
lines.style: Clipped directive. Minimal elaboration. The speaking style of someone confident the instruction is clear. Brief pause between phrases for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社名を略して通称にしました
lines.en: Yes. We've standardized our naming conventions across all channels.
lines.style: Professional status update. Steady, unhurried. Slight emphasis on 'standardized' to highlight the systematic approach. Factual without embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 反応を測って戦略を見直せ
lines.en: Gauge customer response carefully and adjust our strategy accordingly.
lines.style: Measured instruction with underlying pragmatism. Slight deliberate pause after 'carefully' to underscore the importance. Thoughtful rather than rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類を揃えるよう徹底しております
lines.en: Yes. We're ensuring all documentation is complete and properly organized.
lines.style: Final confirmation—thorough and complete. Steady, professional delivery. A touch of finality in the cadence. Closing the briefing with reassurance.
